scope_policy: Current scientific claims are the declared families and their explicit records, plus audit:value selectors on the declared surfaces. Unmarked prose is not discovered by decimal, citation-year, test-count or keyword heuristics. Historical discussion is context, not an extra current result. A matching saved table cell is not verified scientific support.

Only AST-classified documentation, not executable literals, is a claim surface.
Sphinx field comments may carry explicit table selectors.
Producer docstrings may carry scientific claims; ordinary comments and runtime strings are not scanned.
Tests verify behavior; their fixture strings are not public scientific claims and their docstrings must not promise unchecked markers.

product_loso.boundary: Three independently held-out strains, six chemostat states; both beta-carotene production rate and lycopene intermediate content. Retrospective strain holdout is not six independent strains, a new host, or prospective validation.

locations.anchor: Predicting how much product you get

nis.boundary: Prior- and population-specific calibration diagnostics on real plates. Time steps are correlated, wells are nested in plates, and a NIS-only or prefix-sample result is not validation of dynamics. The 2000-particle research probe and the 500-particle shipped producer are different configurations.

locations.anchor: What the model can and can't do

biosensor.boundary: Growth-corrected folds and intervals, per-dose detection, whole-sensor dose association, and practical equivalence are distinct questions. An interval containing one or a nonsignificant test does not establish no induction. Missing/negative activities and unresolved intervals remain refusals.

cosmic.boundary: Lexicographic task efficiency is measured flux divided by a sequentially constrained maximum, under an explicit native host and uptake regime. Fixing measured fluxes is not predicting them; a fallback excluding biomass is not a passed full-task test.

native_frozen.boundary: Pinned native checkpoint, strict chemistry refusal, explicitly unverified hypothesis envelopes and retrospective processed-cohort development. Portable replay does not certify new biological-law learning, operator blindness or independent validation.

validation.boundary: Same-teacher recovery, changed-equation simulation, held-out real data and registered-then-measured prospective validation must not be pooled. Failure to reject a random-axis null is not equivalence. HOG held-out measurements remain within the published model-development lineage.

locations.anchor: What the model can and can't do

pathway_environment.boundary: PHB environment data, fitted environment laws and GEM yield/supply sensitivity are condition-specific evidence. A feasible ceiling is not a realized product flux; held-out carbon sources are not independent papers.

kinetic_calibration.boundary: Conditional branch fits and uncertainty propagation on Elizondo's six states. Pooling or a large F-test p-value does not establish absence of a strain effect; simulated interval checks do not measure biological coverage.

maintenance.boundary: Deterministic NGAM sensitivity on an explicitly constrained GEM. Respiratory and oxygen-capped fermentative regimes are different conditions; model-derived slopes are not measurements of stress ATP cost.

proteomics.boundary: Simulation of possible protein-assay gains conditional on assumed assay error. No actual protein measurement or real biological validation is claimed.

power.boundary: Synthetic detection/attribution power under the supplied generator, loadings and noise. It is not wet-lab power established independently of the simulator.
